_comment: Read by scripts/check-npm-audit.py (pre-push hook and Dependency Audit). One entry per advisory, never per package. An expired entry fails the gate; renew it only with a reason that is still true.

exceptions.reason: No patched version exists (braces <= 3.0.3, last release 2024). Reached through @scalar/api-client and @scalar/components -> @headlessui/tailwindcss -> tailwindcss 3 -> micromatch/chokidar/fast-glob. braces expands glob patterns at build time; no request path passes user input to it.
